descriptions.g1p_choice_tint_802a6878: Updates observed choice-control enables and tints after native availability and busy queries. Enables confirm with the availability result; constructs grey150 or255 RGB and opaque alpha. Disabled/busy uses200,150,200 tint and observed alternate controls; active state uses opaque white and selects left/right through the secondary panel index at+28. Applies shade and grey to alternating observed labels and cast controls. Complete local RGBA values are4 bytes; all receiver/secondary/control views are partial and external. Guarded and unguarded enable calls preserve exact original null-check locations; names/roles inferred. No owned data, artificial storage or instruction controls.
